description: Ecommerce and DTC brands, online coaching businesses, and digital marketing / social media / personal brand agencies found via Google Maps. Scraped LOCALLY on Mustafa's PC by the self-hosted gosom/google-maps-scraper (Docker, localhost:8080) because the cloud Phase 1 routine cannot reach localhost. The local pre-scrape runs at 10:00 PM PKT the night before (Sun-Wed) and pushes raw leads to GitHub under the NEXT day's date; cloud Phase 1 at 8:00 AM PKT filters, enriches, writes and logs them like Campaigns 1-3.

google_maps.local_schedule: 10:00 PM PKT, Sun-Wed nights (Windows task FASTECH-C4-Scrape on Mustafa's PC); output goes to the next day's leads folder for the 8:00 AM PKT Phase 1

rotation.rule: One search term + one city per run. day_index = date.toordinal(). term = search_terms[day_index % 7], city = cities[day_index % 15]. 7 and 15 share no factors, so every term x city pair (105) is covered before any repeats. US and UK cities only (EU and other regions removed 2026-10-16).
rotation.send_bucket_note: The Phase 2/3/4 send routines pick leads by timezone = US-East / UK / US-West. C4 leads get their city's send_bucket written into the timezone field so they are picked up without changing the send routines. UK cities go out in the UK phase. Central US (Chicago, Austin, Houston) goes with US-East (7:30 AM local). LA, Seattle and Denver go with US-West.

target_personas: Digital marketing and social media marketing agency owners (white-label video partner angle)
Content creation studios that do NOT produce video in-house (video/production studios are competitors - skip)

target_decision_maker.note: Google Maps rarely lists a person. The decision maker's first name must come from the personal email (jane@brand.com) or the website's About/Team page via Firecrawl. No first name = RED.

email_angle: Reference their actual brand, product line, coaching offer or agency services from their website. Brands and coaches: they live or die on short-form video (Reels, TikTok, product videos, ads) and most small teams can't produce enough of it. Agencies (digital marketing / social media / personal brand): FASTECH as their white-label video team - they sell it, FASTECH edits overnight. Never pitch generic 'video editing services'.

skip_competitors.rule: Skip any video/film/production/editing/animation/content-production business — they are FASTECH competitors, not clients.

filtering_rules.green_only_if: Personal/direct email found (firstname@domain, name.surname@domain, or a personal Gmail/Outlook tied to the founder). Role emails in C4 are RED, not YELLOW.

extract_fields: founder / owner first name (About, Team, Our Story pages)
tone — casual founder or polished brand
